paper.title: Wang, Sankaran & Perdikaris (2022), Respecting causality is all you need for training physics-informed neural networks
paper.scope: Independent harmonic-oscillator ODE adaptation of section 3 residual weighting. Hard initial values, eight bins and a fixed training ceiling; not chaotic/turbulent benchmarks or full Algorithm 1 reproduction.

sources.name: Wang, Sankaran & Perdikaris (2022), Respecting causality is all you need for training physics-informed neural networks
sources.text: Section 3, especially equations 3.1–3.3: ordered residual losses with detached exponential prefix weights. Our oscillator, hard initial condition and fixed training ceiling are independent teaching adaptations, not the paper’s chaotic or turbulent benchmarks.

sources.name: Authors’ CausalPINNs implementation
sources.text: Original implementation and benchmark details. The paper also uses time windows and modified MLPs; those are not reproduced here.

sources.name: All nine CPU oscillator runs and temporal gate histories
sources.text: Three seeds, uniform/fixed-epsilon/annealed-epsilon policies, 64 residual times in eight ordered bins, 1298 parameters, hard initial values, 90-second cap and 6000-update ceiling. Actual steps, epsilon events, energy and held-out residuals are disclosed.
